newsitem.title: UK: Littlewoods to probe Hilfiger claim.
newsitem.headline: Littlewoods to probe Hilfiger claim.

text.p: British retail group Littlewoods LWD.CN Home Shopping said on Friday it would not knowingly sell any counterfeit merchandise and was investigating a complaint by U.S. fashion group Tommy Hilfiger Corporation about alleged trademark infringement.

"Littlewoods Home Shopping Group maintains a policy of selling branded products that, to the best of our knowledge, are original products. Littlewoods would not knowingly sell any counterfeit merchandise," the company, part of Britain's largest private retail and leisure group , said in a statement.

Hilfiger said earlier on Friday it was seeking compensation and damages from Littlewoods Warehouses Ltd. It alleged that Littlewoods was selling products which infringed various Tommy Hilfiger trademarks.
